{{Quote|Kareena&mdash;would you explain that the two-time Supreme Hunter of the Goa-Ato is not intimidated by any Howling Tempest Gang scum?|Gorro|<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Rodian Hunt}}</ref>}}
'''Supreme Hunter''' was the title given to the hunter who won a competition held by the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Gorro]] was a two-time Supreme Hunter, and one Supreme Hunter paid for leads on the whereabouts of previous winners during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Mission" />
